tools.name: get_next_public_holidays
tools.description: List the upcoming public holidays for a country. Returns the next public holidays (from today onward) for the given country. Returns: Array of upcoming public holidays..

tools.name: get_public_holidays
tools.description: List public holidays for a country and year. Returns every public holiday of the given year for the given country, with local and English names, date and scope. Returns: Array of public holidays for the requested year and country..
